name: Setlist bingo
summary: A shared 5x5 card of songs and show moments; mark what happens, see friends' marks, first full line is bingo.
useWhen: friends at the same concert or show who want a game while it happens
'setlist bingo', 'bet they open with Texas Sun', 'bingo for the show'
dontUseWhen: a bingo of things that happen in the chat or on a trip (use road-bingo)
picking which show to go to (use poll)

params.title: string
params.cells: 24 short labels, row by row, center skipped
params.played: indices 0-23 into cells already played, in order
